compliance.message: ZATCA rejected the CSR: The provided Certificate Signing Request (CSR) is invalid. — The CSR must be generated by the ZATCA SDK using the same EGS serial number and VAT number that was registered on the portal when the OTP was issued. You cannot use a pre-generated or mismatched CSR.
